messages.subject: Stability and installation on windows
messages.body_plain:
Hi there, just to let you know that while now version 0.8.2-1 is
installing and running on Windows, I've noticed that is a little clumsy on
the start-up process. Till the point, that every time that a new session is
started the program will crash and until de second time around it will
start, with a message to recover the last working session.
I tried version rkward-master-2221-windows-cl-msvc2022-x86_64.exe , but it
regressed to the  error that the file "kdesigleapplicaition-qt6.dll" was
missing.
Regards
Alfonso

I started the RKWard pre-release version

Fedora 43 KDE installation. I had updated my system which included Qt 6.10.1
with dnf offline-upgrade about 2 hours earlier. RKWard crashed when starting
about 2 s after it appeared. The crash was in
QtWebEngineCore::ContentClientQt::SetGpuInfo at
/usr/src/debug/qt6-qtwebengine-6.10.1-2.fc43.x86_64/src/core/content_client_qt.cpp:528.

trace. I'm reporting the second crash. The problem didn't happen with Qt
6.10.0.
